==Notes==
*Consider combating with skills that transfer conditions among foes: [[Fevered Dreams]], [[Extend Conditions]], [[Epidemic]], etc. Aggressive Oozes are usually with several other casters and spreading [[Dazed]] (which they inflict on themselves) will make the group considerably less harmful.
